title: Source-Weight Boundary and Topology-Only Spectral Test
status: SOURCE WEIGHT GAP CONFIRMED + SCALE-FREE/TOPOLOGY SPECTRAL ORGANIZATION FOUND
ruling: The archive does not license a physical numerical W_ij for the E019 endogenous ER witness. A topology-only equal-weight Laplacian is therefore the strongest non-invented instance spectral comparator presently available. On that comparator, endogenous history is strongly low-frequency organized: adjacency/corridor/persistence share the same dominant nonzero topology mode, while chirality is dominated by an even lower mode and places ~94.5% of centered power in the lowest 10% of nonzero modes. All four low-mode concentrations exceed 1000 permutation controls at p<=0.001. This establishes spectral organization of the route component, not a physical H_g eigenmode.
